entities.summary: Evgeny Viktorovich Skachkov is a Russian-born Romanian professional ice hockey winger who currently plays for HC Ugra of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the St. Louis Blues in the 7th round of the 2003 NHL entry draft.
